Environmental Intelligence
PILLAR 01 — BASELINES
The real environment, learned per channel: magnetic, electric, ultrasonic or anything else that emits numbers. Learn it, lock it, save it, and compare against it.
Pillar 01

Learn · lock · compare

Each channel learns its reference from the real environment it sits in. Lock the reference and every change after that is measured against it; it never drifts toward a new signal on its own.

Save a learned environment under a name and compare against it later. Simulated data is refused: a saved environment is evidence.
